description: The heat rod written as typed equations on a grid (ADR 0060): the rod is a line of 50 cells, T has a value per cell, and dT/dt = alpha*lap(T) is the heat equation. The edge line holds the ends at the left and right temperatures. Compare with the built-in 'Heat along a rod' example: the same physics in four lines you can edit. Try a periodic rod (edge T: x periodic), an insulated one (delete the edge line), or a heat source term in the rate.

blocks.name: rod
equations: # heat along a rod of length 'length', held at 'left' and 'right' at its ends
edge T: x- = left, x+ = right
